english:
Then for the Saints: Eugenia the virgin, and her father Philip, and her mother Claudia, and her two brothers Sergius and Apito, and the two Eunuchs.
Midday Liturgy:
Psalm 44 [45] (Incipit: "They shall be brought..." [verse 14]).
Proverbs 1:20: "Wisdom [cries] at the exits..." to verse 25: "...and you would not listen."
Prophet Isaiah 55:10: "Thus says the Lord: For as [the rain]..." to verse 13: "...and it shall not fail."
Epistle Romans 15:30: "I appeal to you, brethren..." to verse 33: "...be with you all. Amen."
Alleluia: "The queen shall stand..."
Gospel Luke 12:32: "Do not fear, little flock..." to verse 40: "...the Son of Man [comes]."

Then for Saint Gregory the Theologian:
Morning Hymn Tone 1 [ak]: "Who adorned..."
Patristic Hymn Tone 8 [dz]: "Wondrous worker."
Magnificat and Entrance Hymn Tone 3 [by]: "Who with light..."
Midday Liturgy:
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let [your] priests..."
Proverbs 8:33: "Hear wisdom..." to verse 36: "...love death."
Prophet Hosea 10:12: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 12: "...the fruits of righteousness."
Prophet Amos 5:10: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 14: "...the Lord God Almighty."
Acts 20:25: "And now, behold..." to verse 32: "...among all the saints."
Alleluia: "You are a priest..."
Gospel John 10:11: "I am the shepherd..." to verse 16: "...one flock and one shepherd."

Then for the Holy Martyrs: Eugenius, Macarius, Valerius, Candidus, and Aquilas.
Midday Liturgy:
Psalm 115 [116]: "Precious is..."
Prophet Zephaniah 3:19: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 20: "...before your eyes, says the Lord."
Epistle 2 Corinthians 10:3: "Brethren, though [we walk]..." to verse 6: "...your obedience is complete."
Alleluia: Martyrs' [tone].
Gospel Matthew 10:23: "And when they persecute..." to verse 33: "...who is in heaven."

[Corrupted/Unintelligible lines]

But on the Sunday of the Eve of the Catechumens [Arachavor], say the final Tone 8 [dz] Patristic Hymn: "Glorifying."
Magnificat Tone 7 [gy]: "Rejoice, Mother of God, most blessed."
Midday Liturgy:
Psalm 64 [65]: "To you is due..."
Prophet Isaiah 61:10: "My soul shall rejoice in the Lord..." to 62:9: "...in the courts of my holiness."
Epistle 2 Timothy 2:15: "Be diligent to present yourself..." to verse 26: "...for his will."
Alleluia: Resurrection, according to the proper tone of the day.
Gospel John 6:15: "Jesus, when he perceived..." to verse 21: "...at the land where they were going."

Canon of the Forty-Day Coming of Christ our God into the Temple [Presentation / Candlemas]:

Now, the feast of the Forty-Day Coming of Christ into the Temple is placed here, which is called "The Lord's Presentation" [Tyarn'ndaraj], and is always celebrated on February 14; which you must perform as follows:
On the 13th day of February, in the evening, first say: "Bow down [your ear]" and "Save [me]."
"Gladsome Light" [Phos Hilaron].
Gradual [Mesedi] of the Coming: "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; the Lord God has appeared to us."
Litany: "Let us say."
"Holy God," who came and art to come.
Entrance Hymn Tone 1 [ah]: "Incarnate from the Virgin."
Afterward, the Litany: "For peace."
Prayer: "Compassionate Father."
And the priests shall vest together, and they shall go out with the cross, the gospel, and all ornaments to the portal, singing the hymn Tone 7 [bg]: "Today, the unoriginated birth..." with its proper verses.
And at the conclusion of the hymn, Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends have seen..."
Response: "Sing to the Lord."
Reading, Leviticus 12:6: "And the Lord said to Moses..." to verse 8: "...and she shall be cleansed."
Proverbs 8:22: "The Lord created me..." to verse 24: "...who keeps my ways."
Prophet Ezekiel 44:1: "And he brought me back..." to verse 2: "...and it shall be shut."
Prophet Malachi 3:1: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 4: "...and as in former years."
Epistle Galatians 3:24: "Therefore the law was our tutor..." to verse 29: "...heirs according to the promise."
Alleluia: "Blessed is he who is to come."
Gospel Luke 2:22: "And when [the days] were fulfilled..." to verse 40: "...was upon him."
Litany: "For the peace from above," and they shall bless the four corners of the world [Antasdan].
Litany: "By this holy cross."
Prayer: "Protect [us]."
And they shall light the fire, and they shall sing the canticles: "Christ of glory..."
And then: "Save [us]."
And they shall be dismissed.
(Note: The practice of walking around the fire is objectionable, which was introduced by the ignorant.)
